The '''Orbital Deployment Center''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The city's purpose was to run and maintain the [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the planet and monitored nearby [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the hopes of locating targets for O'reenian [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to raid and recover advanced technological weaponry.<ref name="UR ">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
